messages:
maria: heads-up — saw a 2-3x tail latency regression on 8x A100 runs after enabling CUDA graphs + KV prefetching. happens only under steady state, looks like comm/compute overlap disappears
ben: which job/run id?
maria: run/2026-03-17/infra-8g-graph/4571 (in logs)
ci-bot: perf-alert: latency_p99 increased 2.9x on run 4571 compared to baseline 4560
li: quick question — are we capturing the all-reduce into the graph or is it launched on a different stream?
maria: capture includes forward/backward and the communication primitive. before graphs we had explicit async all-reduce on comm stream that overlapped compute. after capture it seems serialized
oliver: can you paste a short nvprof/NVTX timeline? even a screenshot-style ASCII helps
maria: pasted a trimmed trace:
```
NVTX: [CAPTURE_START]
stream:0 kernel: fwd_1  (0-1ms)
stream:0 kernel: fwd_2  (1-2ms)
stream:1 allreduce  (2-5ms)  <-- used to run concurrently with fwd_2
stream:0 kernel: fwd_3  (5-6ms)
NVTX: [CAPTURE_END]
```
li: looks like allreduce got serialized inside the captured graph region. graph capture semantics can force ordering if the allreduce is on a stream that got captured or implicitly synchronized
ben: did any recent change touch stream creation / default stream behavior? I recall a commit that switched to `cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking)` (a3b7f9e)
devon: a3b7f9e was for stream priority to improve small-batch latency. could be interacting with capture + prefetch ordering
maria: repro plan: 1) run identical config with capture disabled 2) run capture but move allreduce to un-captured stream 3) try `cudaStreamBeginCapture(stream, cudaStreamCaptureModeGlobal)` vs thread-local
oliver: also try setting `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` in a local repro (just to confirm ordering dependency) and run with `nvtxMarkA` markers around KV prefetch calls
sre-bot: note: when graphs capture external dependencies they insert host syncs in some drivers (tracked in ticket GPU-1228)
li: small experiment: I switched our capture wrapper to use `cudaStreamCaptureModeThreadLocal` for the comm stream and the allreduce stayed overlapped in a quick smoke test (not full perf run)
maria: interesting — thread-local capture preserves overlap in your smoke? what about full 8 GPU run?
li: not yet, will run tomorrow.
ben: another hypothesis: KV prefetch is submitting kernels on a transient stream that gets folded into the graph capture. if prefetch runs on the same stream as capture it will be part of graph, and that may reorder comms. try pinning prefetch to a dedicated non-captured stream
devon: code snippet to force prefetch on dedicated stream: `cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&kv_stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking); nvtxRangePushA("kv-prefetch"); launch_prefetch(kv_stream); nvtxRangePopA();`
maria: I'll try pinning prefetch + thread-local capture + explicit comm stream outside capture. will post numbers
oliver: also capture a cupti timeline if possible — driver-level syncs show up there
ci-bot: triggered repro fleet job 4578 (8x A100, capture-threadlocal-prefetch-isolated)
maria: quick update: 4578 reduced p99 by ~35% vs 4571 but we still see a 1.4x gap to baseline (no-graph). so partial win
li: partial win suggests multiple factors. maybe kernel fusion in graphs changes launch timings and the allreduce op is slightly delayed, enough to reduce overlap when shapes are near threshold
ben: can we instrument per-step timestamps around: KV enqueue, capture begin/end, allreduce launch, kernel queueing? tiny patches with NVTX calls will help isolate
maria: agreed. I'll add NVTX spans around enqueue/submit and push a small PR to our perf branch. assigning @oliver to debug the cupti trace and @devon to try non-captured comm stream variant in a full run
oliver: on it — I'll check driver behavior across CUDA 12.2 vs 12.3 too, some graph fixes landed there
devon: I'll run non-captured comm stream experiment and post results here later today
ben: thanks team. if we can get a minimal repro (small model, 2 GPUs) that shows the serialization that will be gold for a bisect/driver bug report
maria: agree. next steps logged in issue runtime/COMM-921. leaving log snippets and the CI job links in the ticket :eyes:
ci-bot: job 4578 finished (partial improvement)
